text:
```artifact
Feature: Admin and Patient functionalities for editing labs/pharmacy details, registration, profile updates, appointments, consultations, and prescriptions
  Scenario: Admin can update lab details
    Given an admin user with access to lab management
    When the admin edits lab details
    Then the updated information should be reflected in the system
    And the admin should be redirected to the lab management page
  Scenario: Admin can delete lab details
    Given an admin user with access to lab management
    When the admin deletes lab details
    Then the lab details should be removed from the system
    And the admin should be redirected to the lab management page

Feature: Patient functionalities for registration
  Scenario: Patient can register
    Given an empty registration system
    When a patient registers
    Then the system should record the new patient
    And the patient should be redirected to the registration confirmation page

Feature: Patient functionalities for updating profile
  Scenario: Patient can update profile
    Given a registered patient with a profile
    When the patient updates their profile
    Then the new profile information should be saved
    And the patient should be redirected to the profile edit page

Feature: Patient functionalities for making appointments and submitting online consultation requests
  Scenario: Patient can make appointments
    Given a registered patient
    When the patient schedules an appointment
    Then the appointment should be confirmed
    And the patient should receive a confirmation email

Feature: Patient functionalities for viewing and generating prescription reports and invoices
  Scenario: Patient can view and generate prescription reports
    Given a patient with prescriptions
    When the patient requests a report
    Then the system should generate a detailed report
    And the patient should receive an invoice

Feature: Doctor functionalities for providing consultation
  Scenario: Doctor can provide consultation
    Given a registered doctor
    When the doctor provides consultation
    Then the patient should receive a confirmation of the appointment

Feature: Doctor functionalities for prescribing medicine
  Scenario: Doctor can prescribe medicine
    Given a registered doctor with prescription privileges
    When the doctor prescribes medicine
    Then the prescription should be added to the patient's record

Feature: Doctor functionalities for prescribing lab tests
  Scenario: Doctor can prescribe lab tests
    Given a registered doctor with lab test privileges
    When the doctor prescribes lab tests
    Then the tests should be added to the patient'se lab request

```
